versions.changelog: Reduce false-positive moderation noise without changing SVG runtime behavior: safer wearable build helper, clearer install/env declarations, and a tighter published bundle.
Tighten public docs so the published skill matches the live SVG behavior: fixed common background by default, rarity-tier overrides on request, and clearer Telegram delivery guidance.
Refresh clean OG SVG bundle with Telegram PNG delivery, wearable exception handling, and prompt-driven rarity background controls.

aavegotchi-svg-custom 1.1.0

- Adds support for rendering classic OG Aavegotchi SVGs and PNGs from Base, including hypothetical custom loadouts and existing token IDs.
- Supports plain-language prompts for generating pixel/SVG-style gotchis (e.g. custom wearables, token IDs, specific backgrounds).
- Generates PNGs by default alongside SVGs for improved chat/Telegram compatibility.
- Applies official wearable layering logic and outputs front, left, right, and back angles plus a manifest.
- Strongly routes "classic", "OG", "SVG", or "Base" Aavegotchi image requests to this skill, not 3D renders.
- Provides helper scripts for easy chat delivery and local/manual rendering.
